limitations: No sampled local audit constitutes an induction proof.
Graph SCCs use individual child arcs for scheduling; acceptance retains every mandatory child.
The complete retained-rule greatest fixed point is empty; this says nothing about ungenerated rules.
Prioritized search is heuristic and not claimed complete or guaranteed to terminate successfully.
The floating-point discovery filters affect exploration only; a closed candidate still needs independent exact verification.
The first three runs predate persistent global attempt counts. Later four branch histories are pooled by maximum, not sum.
